potts_beta_binomial_equations.beta_binomial_likelihood: p(k_s | n_s, theta_s) with theta_s integrated under Beta(alpha_s, beta_s)
potts_beta_binomial_equations.cold_start_rule: uniform q_i over states; alpha_s=beta_s=1 before exact observations
potts_beta_binomial_equations.online_mean_field_update: q_i(s) proportional to exp(E_q[-log likelihood_i(s)] + beta * sum_j w_ij q_j(s))
potts_beta_binomial_equations.potts_prior: P(z) proportional to exp(beta * sum_edges w_ij * 1[z_i=z_j])
